jobs_results.description:
Trabajar en Apiumhub implica un desarrollo constante. Valoramos la capacidad de atención, escucha y trabajo en equipo. Cada viernes, tenemos reuniones de open space donde tenemos la oportunidad de hablar y aprender unos de los otros mientras tomamos una cerveza!

Apiumhub es un hub de desarrollo de software y un lugar seguro para el autodesarrollo. Conecta a las grandes mentes, creando una reserva de conocimiento renovable.

Beneficios
• Contrato permanente
• 23 días de vacaciones
• Política de teletrabajo
• Oficina en el centro de Barcelona
• Snacks, café y cerveza gratis
• Seguro médico con cobertura dental
• Clases de inglés gratuitas
• Presupuesto para aprendizaje continuo y formación
• Presupuesto para equipos para actividades
• Workshops técnicos e informales
• Eventos de empresa offsite
• Únete a una familia en crecimiento con un gran sentido del humor y un entorno saludable

En Apiumhub somos especialistas multiculturales en arquitectura y desarrollo de software, impulsados... por nuestra pasión por entregar software que funcione. Nos encanta compartir tiempo de calidad entre nosotros y divertirnos, más allá de nuestra relación profesional. Consulta nuestras ofertas de trabajo y forma parte de una familia que crece sin perder su esencia.

jobs_results.title: SR RUBY ON RAILS DEVELOPER
jobs_results.description:
Este es un puesto de trabajo remoto.

Como desarrollador senior RoR tus principales responsabilidades serán:
• Desarrollar y hacer mantenimiento de los sistemas backend y herramientas internas.
• Comprender los objetivos comerciales y cómo la tecnología puede ayudar a alcanzarlos.
• Monitorear y resolver problemas de sistemas en vivo.
• Crear y mejorar los procesos de CI/CD para facilitar el desarrollo y la implementación de productos.
• Mejorar la arquitectura y la escalabilidad de los servicios de cara al usuario.
• Actualizar y agregar nuevas integraciones API con sistemas de terceros.

Requisitos

Habilidades principales:
• Ruby on Rails
• CI/CD
• Redis

Habilidades blandas:
• Proactividad
• Buena comunicación
• Organización

Habilidades segundarías:
• Amplio conocimiento sobre uno o más frameworks de cliente JS.
• Experiencia previa con integraciones de proveedores de pagos.
• Conocimiento del ecosistema de monetización de publicidad móvil.
• Alto dominio de pruebas unitarias y... de integración.

Ventajas
• Paquete de compensación competitivo.
• Modelo de trabajo híbrido y de alta flexibilidad.
• Alto grado de propiedad y autonomía..
• Ser parte de un pequeño equipo de profesionales altamente motivados y talentosos

jobs_results.title: Ruby on Rails Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Summary

We are looking for a remote Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer with strong knowledge in application backend development to join our development team. This is a long-term full-time (40 hrs/wk) contract role.

What You’ll Do:
• Communicate with the Engineering Manager and with frontend developers to establish priorities and plan the application roadmap.
• Suggest performance improvements and provide assistance with application architecture design.
• Point out potential performance problems and suggest fixes.
• Develop new web services with Ruby on Rails.

What You Should Have:
• 4+ years of experience with Ruby on Rails applications (mandatory).
• Knowledge of JavaScript, and Postgres or MySQL.
• Experience with unit testing (rspec, Jest, etc.) and background workers (Sidekiq).
• Experience working from design docs/specifications and frameworks.
• Knowledge of Vue.js, React, Solr, service workers architecture, and advanced SQL (nice to have).

We're hiring people based in one of the... following countries: the United States, Canada, Brazil, Spain, Portugal, Romania, or Poland.

Benefits:
• Hubstaff is a fast-growing time-tracking and project management startup that fully embraces remote work.
• Our team has people from 30 different countries: we value and welcome diverse backgrounds.
• We expect our professionals to work 40 hours/week and hope they can work with us for years to come.
• We are looking for someone in the American or EMEA timezone for this particular position.
• Flexibility is essential to us, so Hubstaff offers this flexibility in your day-to-day life and also in terms of contract type.
• Our professionals can be hired as contractors (payment/hour) or as employees in more than 25 countries (salaried and getting additional benefits like vacations, paid leaves as sick or maternity or paternity leave, equipment and training bonuses, and health insurance, among others).
• We get the whole team together on our Annual Retreats to have fun while traveling and getting to know each other! So, while 2020 had us virtually meeting because of the pandemic, we met in person in the Dominican Republic in 2022 and in Mexico in 2023, and we are now preparing an outstanding in-person retreat in Europe for this year, 2024. Ready to join us?
• Annual Salary: this will depend on your country's location/currency/taxes and, most importantly, based on your experience/skills. But you should expect a yearly gross salary between USD 80,000.00 and USD 100,000.00.

Curious? You can find more about Hubstaff and what it's like working with us here. In addition, you can read more about us on our website and learn more about our history and work philosophy on our blog

jobs_results.title: Ruby on rails developer/senior developer
jobs_results.description:
AppDrawn are looking to recruit a software developer to join our team of developers with experience and passion in development. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced developer with a minimum of 1 years experience. You’ll be working on the full process of the projects from beginning to the end and could get involved in all of the steps of creating the apps. As a boutique web app development company, we have a clear objective: to create innovative and bespoke web apps to elevate businesses. Our primary technology stack is Ruby-on-Rails with ReactJS for web apps and ReactNative for mobile apps.

The role
We are looking for a hard-working member of our team to come on full-time in our office based in central Barcelona.

We are looking for someone who has long-term residency in Barcelona and who is fluent in English.

Essential experience
- Ruby on Rails but other related experience may be accepted
- ReactJS
- HTML/CSS/JS

Desirable skills
- Experience with: Bootstrap... ReactNative, MySQL, Docker, Git

Our ideal candidate will be:
- Honest and straight forward
- Have the ability to adapt to new challenges
- Great at problem solving

What we offer:
- Friendly and supportive team.
- Office in central Barcelona with easy access via public transport.
- Flexible holidays.

Background: AppDrawn is a small but fast-growing web and mobile application development award-winning agency with 22 years of experience. Our core focus is on business applications and bespoke platform development. We currently manage projects from our UK office, serving clients predominantly in the London area. The development team are at Barcelona office. This role would be based in Barcelona.

We have an internal deadline of Friday 3rd June 2022 but we will be interviewing before and after then and so we encourage you to apply asap if you are interested

jobs_results.title: Programador Ruby on Rails y Angular Js fullstack
jobs_results.description:
Buscamos a un desarrollador idealmente full-stack, fluido en Ruby on Rails y Angular Js .

Aunque si se dominan tecnologías similares y se dispone de una actitud buena frente a aprender nuevos lenguajes de programación también nos vale.

El candidato estaría involucrado de forma transversal en el desarrollo del producto Loyal Guru.

Nuestra infraestructura tecnológica es completamente Api-Driven.

Tenemos varias API's a modo de microservicios que son el corazón de toda la lógica de negocio.

Estos servicios vienen consumidos por 3 aplicaciones desarrolladas internamente ( aplicación móvil hibrida cliente, plataforma web, aplicación móvil establecimiento ) y además por los sistemas de nuestros clientes ( TPV's, ERP's etc.. ).

Gestionamos GB de datos de forma diaria con lo que el componente BIG DATA en nuestro negocio también es importan.

Dada la diversidad de tecnologías involucradas en nuestro producto, La experiencia que el candidato puede acumular es muy interesante y existe una... gran oportunidad de crecimiento profesional dentro de la empresa.

Características que valoramos en el candidato.

Conocimientos de back-end:
• Ruby on Rails
• Conocimientos sólidos de bases de datos relacionales ( Idealmente PostgreSQL)
• Desarrollo con TDD
• Experiencia trabajando en equipo con GIT

Conocimientos front-end:
• Experiencia desarrollando en Angular JS ( o frameworks similares )
• Maquetación: HTML/CSS
• Javascript básico

Se valorará positivamente:
• Experiencia con algún sistema de colas ( Sidekiq, Resque, Delayed Job,... )
• Experiencia con el framework de aplicaciones híbridas Ionic Framework
• Experiencia en Big Data (google big query, hadoop, solr, lucene, )
• Conocimientos de Machine Learning
• Experiencia con algún sistema de ETL
• Experiencia con Heroku ( web dynos, worker dynos, etc..)
• Experiencia en creación de aplicaciones híbridas (phonegap/cordova + html5 + js)
• Experiencia en desarrollo nativo para iOs o Android
• Conocimientos de GoLang

Condiciones
• Tipo de industria de la oferta: Internet
• Categoría: Informática y telecomunicaciones - Programación
• Nivel: Empleado/a
• Salario: 27.000€ - 36.000€ Bruto/año

Requisitos
• Estudios mínimos: Ingeniero Técnico
• Experiencia mínima: Al menos 2 años

Conocimientos necesarios
• Ruby On Rails
• AngularJS
• angular
• Ruby
• PostgresSQL
• API
• HTML5
• CSS
• JavaScript
• Test-driven Development (TDD)

Tipo de puesto: Indefinido

Sueldo: 31.000,00€ al año

• puesto similar: 2 años (Requisito mínimo

Dada la diversidad de tecnologías involucradas en nuestro producto, La experiencia que el candidato puede acumular es muy interesante y existe una... gran oportunidad de crecimiento profesional dentro de la empresa.

jobs_results.description:
Posición: Product Engineer (Ruby on Rails) in Early Stage Startup

The ideal candidate for this position is an experienced Ruby on Rails Full Stack Developer who possesses infinite curiosity. As a result, the candidate should have a track record in scoping and execution of agile sprint methods (Epic definition, product cycle management and time boxing). Moreover, the candidate should be able to work with other developers in determining product strategy.

Ready to become part and benefit from Metarina's growth story?
Tasks
• Ownership of integral features in the product roadmap
• Partner up with our CTO to create ground-breaking tech by going the extra mile
• Create test driven environment for relevant projects
Requirements
• 3 (+-) years of proven relevant work experience as a (full-stack) software engineer
• Proficiency with Ruby (on Rails), experience with relational databases and SQL
• Experience with agile sprint methodologies
• Excitement to engage with to other (non-tech) team... members
Benefits
• Responsibility in a fast-growing startup environment.
• Be part of a highly motivated crew, eager to shake up a traditional industry.
• Dynamic & remote work.

Metarina originated from a recurring struggle on the high seas in the Mediterranean at the end of 2019. At the time, two of the co-founders, as crew of a traditional sailing yacht, found it to be extremely difficult to reliably book a safe harbour. Since then, the then captain Nicola Kienzle, tech entrepreneur Henry Hooper, and senior developer Leon Entrup have been working on creating the optimal link between marinas and boaters.

Together they form the backbone to disrupt the boating world, a sector that is just starting to catch up with the digital transformation of the last decades. With their deep industry knowledge the team has understood and validated the key challenges of marinas not being able to plan their resources optimally. With Metarina, the trio seeks to counter that challenge and to have a lasting and sustainable impact on the entire sector.
#J-18808-Ljbffr
